eng_blog.notes: Two Matillion blog articles describe engineering work on internal/product tools: an intern’s agentic monitoring system and an intern-built pipeline quality reviewer. Their author sections identify software engineering interns, satisfying the two-post technical-content threshold.

public_docs.notes: The public Maia documentation portal describes how-to guides, reference material, API docs, and tutorials, with linked product documentation articles, so this is more than a single FAQ.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live Matillion job posting is titled Senior Staff AI Engineer and includes an application link, so an AI role is open.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Matillion’s live Sales Development Representative posting has an application link and explicitly describes the SDR role, meeting the requested hiring criteria.

launched_6mo.notes: Matillion announced general availability of Maia Foundation on Google BigQuery on July 8, 2026, within the six months before November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Matillion’s August 4, 2026 announcement says Girish Pancha was appointed CEO and Sanjay Krishnamurthi Chief Development Officer, both within the preceding 12 months.
